breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification consistently uses gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack grids (8×8×6 for vc-relax/scf, 12×12×8 for nscf) and makes no mention of a half shift anywhere. This correctly resolves the contradiction between gamma-centered sampling and a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh, matching the ground truth which retains only the gamma-centered grid specification.
